newsitem.title: JAPAN: JGBs end Tokyo lower after confirming ceiling.
newsitem.headline: JGBs end Tokyo lower after confirming ceiling.

text.p: * Key September 10-year JGBs closed lower on profit-taking after the contract confirmed a ceiling at around 124.30.
* Sentiment hurt by falls in bank debentures after domestic report saying MOF's Trust Fund Bureau had not bought bank debentures since April.
